newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish police catch rebels for suicide bomb.
newsitem.headline: Turkish police catch rebels for suicide bomb.

text.p: Turkish police on Friday caught seven rebel Kurds who were behind a suicide bomb attack on a crack police force headquarters that killed four in the southern town of Adana, the state-run Anatolian news agency said.

The news agency gave no further details. A woman bomber dressed to look pregnant blew up herself and four others, including three policemen, in the attack a week ago. It was the second of three human bomb attacks so far by the rebel Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK).
More than 21,000 people have died in the PKK's 12-year-old battle for self-rule in the mainly Kurdish southeast, but the suicide bombings only started this year.
